The infinite conclusion is based on explicit inequalities and endpoint case analysis, not merely experimental saturation.

value.rationale: Lattices of flats are a canonical structural matroid representation. The result gives an exact bounded-rank invariant for every positive-rank uniform matroid, identifies an enduring logical discontinuity between Boolean and genuine truncation even after rank six, and a sharp optimal 121-flat finite kernel. The full classification is naturally motivated and not a routine single-instance calculation.
